FN-KHMMCAA-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 385
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Ben Robbins
Commissions
Analyst: Cary Dean Date: 03/17/2025
House Bill 385 as introduced could increase potential obligations of certain state governmental
entities by an undetermined amount dependent on the difference in the acquisition cost of
property under current law and under this bill without use of eminent domain, as provided by
this bill.
